description: A small hand-picked list of restaurants JumunCheck knows in one country (optionally one city): name, local name, area, cuisine, tags such as english_menu, price level, a typical price per person, address and a map link. Details can be out of date — check before visiting.

city.description: City slug from jumuncheck_get_guide, e.g. seoul.

name: jumuncheck_list_places
title: List JumunCheck restaurants for a country
